item_C.C1_TC01_drawing_callout_rev5: TC-01 drawing, 10x d5.5 J-FWD holes (rev 5): (a) bore-side edge: break R0.1-R0.2, blended and polished, burr-free, no chamfer or step; R0.2 is a HARD MAXIMUM: a hole whose break exceeds R0.2 after rework is rejected or re-assessed, never accepted on sight. (b) flat-side (spot-face) edge of the hole: break 0.1 max. (c) spot-face flat-to-OD edge: break 0.1 max. (d) deburr after match-drilling with TC-02 and after any rework, before anodise. (e) 100 % inspection at 10x before assembly: no burr, nick or raised metal at the hole edges or on the bore within 3 mm of a hole. (f) drawing note: bearing length = wall at the hole minus both breaks (2.665 - 0.2 - 0.1 = 2.365 mm at the drawing-limit wall; the FA1S hole bearing is quoted at this length, +0.005 / +0.239, CHANGELOG 240 (5)). (g) hole size (ADOPTED, lead 14:34Z, Option A): d5.5 +0.12/0 (H12). ENG-HW-101 in-service gauge pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62 (the 5.68 NO-GO pin of hardware_v352 v1.4 is superseded); the line-231 post-FA-1 hole check uses the 5.62 pin. The drawn maximum 5.62 sets the head-bearing ring inner boundary (max(5.62 + 2 x 0.1 break, da 5.7 TO-VERIFY) = 5.82) and the screw float 0.397 mm of the TC-01 flat-bearing rows (rows v5). (h) hole position (ADOPTED, lead 14:34Z): position of each hole axis 0.10 dia to A|B; the d10.5 spot face coaxial with its hole within 0.10 dia. Datum B is NAMED on the drawing (the frame is 'fwd end face A, axis B'; proposal: B = the axis of the 57.25 H8 forward bore, rows v5 rev5_drawing_items). Rows v5 carry the eccentricity (float 0.397 + position 0.05) with the OD 63.5 h9 and its 0.04 runout. Drawing consistency FLAG for rev 5: the r_flat rule 31.313 +0.020/0 'from datum A' and the OD runout 0.04 'to A' are radial quantities and should read 'from / to axis B' (A is the forward end face).
item_C.C2_bore_lead_in_rev5: TC-01 forward bore lead-in 15 deg x 3.5 (x 0.938 mm), replacing 15 deg x 3.0 (x 0.804, which missed Parker PTD5705-EN Fig. 2.24 x > y by 0.0005 mm at the worst stack); it ends 5.75 mm clear of the hole row (holes 12 mm from the end, r 2.75).
item_C.C3_fitting_aid_GSE: ENG-TC-12 J-FWD hole plug set (GSE, not flight mass; TO-DRAW; TO-QUOTE, or made from POM rod): 10 plugs and 1 retaining band. Plug: POM, shank d5.5 -0.02/-0.05; a head shoulder seats on the spot face and sets the depth positively; the inner end is contoured R28.6 (the 57.25 bore; contour depth 0.132 mm over the d5.5 face) with the contour axis parallel to the bore axis, keyed by a tab on the head in a slot of the band (+/-15 deg is enough: the contour error at the plug edge is 0.009 mm at 15 deg [CALC]). Length from the shoulder to the contour centre = the wall measured at that hole (flat to bore along the hole axis) minus 0.025 +/- 0.010, so the end sits 0.015-0.035 below the bore surface (inside the ruled 0 to 0.05; never proud); plugs numbered to their holes. Reason: the drawn wall at the hole spans 2.665-2.708 mm, wider than the 0.05 window, so one fixed length cannot meet it at every stack [CALC]. Band: a split ring over the ten heads on the TC-01 OD that holds each plug against the passing ring's outward push. The plugs come out only after both rings have passed the hole row. BOM line (rev 5): 'ENG-TC-12 | J-FWD hole plug set, 10 plugs + band, O-ring passage aid | GSE (not flight) | POM | qty 1 set | TO-DRAW / TO-QUOTE | used at every TC-02 insertion'.
item_C.C4_assembly_step_founder_procedure: J-FWD build and every re-assembly: 1. inspect the hole edges and the bore per C1 (e); clean. 2. fit the ten ENG-TC-12 plugs in their numbered holes from outside, contour aligned, band on. 3. lubricate S01 and S02 with the selected lubricant (FKM- and N2O-compatible, TO-SELECT with a datasheet; oxygen-clean per the wetted-part rule); fit them into the TC-02 grooves with an even stretch over a cone, no twist (check the mould line). 4. clock TC-02 to the match marks BEFORE the rings enter the lead-in, then push it in axially without rotation until seated. 5. remove the band and the plugs; look through each hole (10x loupe or borescope) for rubber debris or a cut ring; ANY debris: withdraw TC-02, replace both rings and repeat from step 1. 6. fit the ten ENG-HW-101-IN718 screws per J-F1 (LOCTITE 243, 3.0 N m), then the proof / leak test.
item_C.C5_record_why_not_moved: Parker Praedifa PTD5705-EN 2.5.2: a cross-drilled port shears the O-ring as it leaves the drilled area, and the first remedy is to reposition the holes; 2.5.6: bores 'must be removed or covered'. Moving the holes is not possible: S01 and S02 must sit between the chamber and the holes (dry holes), and TC-02 can only enter from the forward end. The internal chamfer (Fig. 2.26) and the balancing groove (Fig. 2.27) change the J-FWD wall and the plug fit contact and are NOT adopted. The fitting aid covers the holes, as 2.5.6 requires; the R0.1-R0.2 break is capped by the bearing length and the screw bending arm (an R0.4 + 0.1 break gives the FA1S hole bearing -0.070 at the nominal wall / -0.080 at the limit wall).
item_C.C6_founder_action_list_related: (1) S01 and S02 are replaced after any FA-1-class event, together with the line-231 J-FWD inspection (lead 10:10Z rule). (2) Line-231 post-FA-1 inspection list: the ten J-FWD screws replaced; the ten holes gauged for elongation and bearing set with the HW-101 pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62 (C1 (g)); a hole that takes the 5.62 pin is rejected; hole edges and the bore within 3 mm of a hole at 10x for nicks or raised metal; S01 / S02 replaced. (3) J-FWD screw life limit: OPEN until the slack-fix ruling (the screw LCF row 183 (1)(c) is a FOUND NEGATIVE, jfwd_screw_lcf_v352_v1.json; quoted as negative, never as passing; the life-limit rows of 2(b) are in bpkg_abort_v352_v1.json).
item_C.C7_datasheet_residuals_gland1: Gland-1 FA1S closes at MS +0.082 on FNST's one-side extrusion limit 0.30 mm (1500 psi row, no interpolation), with the full 0.2772 mm diametral gap taken as one side (nothing centres the plug), entered at the FA-1 fluid bound 93.64 bar abs = 1343 psig (the chart's own axis); Apple Rubber Illustration 5.2 halved at 1343 psi gives +0.16 (support); no back-up ring. Residual: the two makers' curves differ in shape (FNST / Apple 0.48 at 1500 psi) and neither prints a cycle, time or temperature basis.

item_C_geometry_checks.note: CALC: a cylindrical contour rotated by theta about the plug axis misses the bore by sag x sin^2(theta) at the plug edge; one fixed plug length cannot hold 0-0.05 below the bore over the drawn wall range (window 2.658-2.665 mm), hence plugs finished to the measured wall

T-F1: T-F1. Short-time exposure allowables for the 6061-T6 parts TC-01 (case tube) and TC-02 (injector head / forward closure). GATE: before the first static fire. WHY: criterion 183 (1)(d) / 188 (5) needs each part's temperature within a SOURCED time-at-temperature limit. The usable limit on file for 6061-T6 is 150 C (long time). The strength cells use the engmat 10,000 h allowables (conservative for strength), so (d) is reported OPEN, never as passed, for TC-01 and TC-02; it gates nominal operation as well as the abort value. PREDICTED EXPOSURE [SIM, v3.5.2 rev-4 thermal, B1 p99 tg711, gap-conductance bounds GVLO | GVHI]: TC-02 part maximum 188.4 | 181.9 C at the end of burn, above 150 C for 12.3 | 9.9 s per firing. TC-01 part maximum 191.7 | 187.0 C at the chamber bore about 14 mm aft of the injector face, in the soak (51.65 | 43.65 s), above 150 C for 488.8 | 479.5 s per firing; at the J-FWD screw row 159.3 | 129.6 C, 48.5 | 0.0 s above 150 C; while pressurised (burn) TC-01 stays at or below 109.6 | 118.6 C. Over the 50-cycle design life (183 (1)(c)) the cumulative time above 150 C is TC-02 10.2 | 8.2 min and TC-01 6.8 | 6.7 h (part maxima). TB STATE per trial case-abort value A [ASSUMED surrogate, sax.py: the end-of-burn field shifted uniformly so that the TC-01 maximum equals A; the shifted-history times apply the same shift to the whole B1 history and are for sizing only]: A 175 C: TC-02 248.4 | 233.0 C, shifted-history time above 150 C TC-02 1192 | 930 s, TC-01 1436 | 1266 s, margin to the nominal end-of-burn case maximum +65.4 | +56.4 K; A 165 C: TC-02 238.4 | 223.0 C, shifted-history time above 150 C TC-02 862 | 640 s, TC-01 1244 | 1093 s, margin to the nominal end-of-burn case maximum +55.4 | +46.4 K; A 150 C: TC-02 223.4 | 208.0 C, shifted-history time above 150 C TC-02 36 | 30 s, TC-01 999 | 866 s, margin to the nominal end-of-burn case maximum +40.4 | +31.4 K; A 135 C: TC-02 208.4 | 193.0 C, shifted-history time above 150 C TC-02 24 | 18 s, TC-01 790 | 670 s, margin to the nominal end-of-burn case maximum +25.4 | +16.4 K; A 120 C: TC-02 193.4 | 178.0 C, shifted-history time above 150 C TC-02 17 | 11 s, TC-01 606 | 495 s, margin to the nominal end-of-burn case maximum +10.4 | +1.4 K; A 105 C: TC-02 178.4 | 163.0 C, shifted-history time above 150 C TC-02 10 | 5 s, TC-01 438 | 268 s, margin to the nominal end-of-burn case maximum -4.6 | -13.6 K (NOMINAL TRIP on GVLO/GVHI). ROUTE (i), sourced allowables, no test: obtain short-time exposure data for 6061-T6 from a public, citable document (for example MIL-HDBK-5J chapter 3, the 6061 elevated-temperature strength curves with exposure time, or EN 1999-1-2 Table 1a, the 6061-T6 strength ratios for short exposure) and record document, edition, figure or table, page, URL and access date. Read, at each part maximum (nominal as above; TB at the adopted abort value) and for an exposure no shorter than the cumulative time above 150 C of the planned firings, (1) the strength at temperature and (2) the room-temperature strength after the exposure. PASS when (1) is at least the value the cells used (engmat 10,000 h, e.g. Fty / Ftu 116.9 / 134.4 MPa at 188.4 C and 111.2 / 129.2 MPa at 191.7 C; the full table is in this json) and (2) meets the T6 minimums of the stock's own specification (engmat basis ASTM B221 / B241: Fty 240 / Ftu 260 MPa); otherwise T-F3 (the line-212 design change). ROUTE (ii), coupon test on the same stock (the heat / lot of the TC-01 tube and of the TC-02 bar): expose coupons in a calibrated oven (+/-3 K) at the TB part maximum of the adopted abort value, and no lower than the nominal part maximum, for the cumulative hot time of the planned firings (at least the 50-cycle values above, plus every planned TB / abort test event at its shifted-history time); then room-temperature tensile tests (EN ISO 6892-1 or ASTM B557) on at least 3 exposed and 3 unexposed control coupons per stock, same orientation, and hardness (plus eddy-current conductivity if available) on every coupon. PASS when every exposed coupon meets the T6 minimums of the stock specification (Rp0.2, Rm and elongation); hardness and conductivity are recorded as the screening trend, not the pass rule. Optional: one hot tensile at the part maximum after the exposure, at least the engmat value at that temperature. If any exposed coupon fails, (d) stays OPEN and the design goes to T-F3. No recalled or estimated value may replace either route. Until one closes, every quoted TC-01 / TC-02 row carries (d) OPEN; in the abort search, (d) is reported OPEN per abort value with the times above.
